title: pass_through_endpoints strips the JSON-RPC id from request bodies

assertions.why: JSON-RPC responses must echo the request id
control: a non-colliding field survives, proving it is a name collision

observed: Upstream receives the body without id; every response id becomes null and the client cannot correlate. Cause is a pop of every top-level key found in the gateway's internal param list.
preconditions: pass_through_endpoints entry for /canon-skills pointing at a recording stub
